avis.titre: Gentle, But Lacked Impact on My Skin"
avis.texte: I had high hopes when I tried the Heartleaf 77 Soothing Toner, especially given its claims to soothe and hydrate sensitive, dry skin. With 77% Heartleaf extract as the main ingredient, it's designed to calm the skin, which sounded like exactly what my skin needed. The texture of the toner is light and refreshing, and it absorbs quickly, leaving no sticky residue, which I appreciated. However, after using it for a few weeks, I didn't notice any dramatic changes in my skin's overall appearance, texture, or hydration levels. It didn't irritate my skin, which is a definite plus for anyone with sensitive skin like mine. But unfortunately, it didn't deliver on its promise to add extra hydration or provide significant relief from dryness. It felt more like a basic toner rather than something that deeply nourishes or soothes, which is what I was hoping for. While I didn't see noticeable improvements, I can see how this product could be a good option for people who want a gentle toner that won't disrupt the skin's natural balance. It's a great option if you're looking for something mild, but for those with more demanding skin concerns, it may not offer the extra boost you need.

My skin is sensitive, and I noticed it felt a bit dry and itchy after using both the oil cleanser and face wash. One of my main goals in using this skincare system was to reduce dark spots. Toners can help even out skin tone and diminish hyperpigmentation, which is especially beneficial for me. I also appreciate that toners help balance the skin's pH, restoring its natural acidity after cleansing, which can sometimes disrupt the skin's barrier. Another bonus was how it prepared my skin to better absorb the next steps in my routine, like serums and moisturizers. Plus, toners can help seal pores and protect the skin from environmental stressors, making them an essential step in any routine. Overall, this toner felt hydrating and helped combat the dryness caused by cleansing. avis.titre: Lightweight, Hydrating, and Perfect for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: Before trying this product, I'll admit I rarely used toner because I never truly understood its importance in a skincare routine. I thought of it as an optional step that wouldn't make much difference. But I decided to give it a shot, and let me tell you, the results speak for themselves! This toner has completely changed my perspective and has become a must-have in my daily routine. It's incredibly lightweight, absorbing seamlessly into my skin without leaving any sticky or greasy residue. One of the things I appreciate most is how gentle it is. Despite having acne-prone, sensitive, and combination skin with noticeable texture, this toner caused absolutely no irritation. Instead, it works to soothe my skin, leaving it plump, hydrated, and refreshed after every use. The fact that it's fragrance-free is another bonus for me. While I occasionally enjoy lightly scented products, I love that this toner focuses on delivering results without unnecessary additives. Its star ingredient, hyaluronic acid, is a gamechanger. It provides my skin with a boost of hydration that feels luxurious and ensures my skin stays moisturized throughout the day. Overall, this toner exceeded all my expectations. I'm so glad I decided to give it a try it's lightweight, hydrating, soothing, and perfectly complements my skincare routine. If you're on the fence about adding a toner to your regimen, I highly recommend giving this one a shot!
